tests.title: A source tree yields one skill per directory, and underscore directories are not skills
given: a source tree with skills/af-prd/SKILL.md, skills/af-spec/SKILL.md, skills/_shared/references/x.md and a loose file skills/notes.md
tests.when: the source tree is read
then: the skills found are af-prd and af-spec, in that order
_shared is not among them
the loose file skills/notes.md is not a skill
each skill carries its frontmatter text and its body separately, split at the second --- line
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/source_test.go, over a fstest.MapFS: skills, problems = readSource(fsys); assert names(skills) == ['af-prd','af-spec']; assert problems is empty; assert skills[0].body starts after the closing ---

tests.title: A skill includes the files it links and the files those link, its own before the shared ones
given: skills/af-spec/SKILL.md linking references/tasks.md and references/speca-specr.md
skills/af-spec/references/tasks.md, which itself links references/verdict.md
skills/af-spec/references/verdict.md
skills/_shared/references/speca-specr.md
skills/_shared/references/prd-shape.md, which no skill links
tests.when: the files included in af-spec are resolved
then: the included set is tasks.md, speca-specr.md and verdict.md
speca-specr.md resolves to the shared copy because af-spec has none of that name
prd-shape.md is not included
a name present in the skill's own references/ resolves there and not in the shared directory
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/source_test.go: included = resolveRefs(skills['af-spec']); assert keys(included) == {'tasks.md','speca-specr.md','verdict.md'}; assert included['speca-specr.md'].from == 'skills/_shared/references/speca-specr.md'

tests.title: A link that resolves in neither references directory is a problem naming both directories
given: skills/af-spec/SKILL.md linking references/tasks.md, with no tasks.md in either references directory
tests.when: the source tree is checked
then: one problem is reported
its text is exactly `skills/af-spec/SKILL.md: links references/tasks.md, which is in neither skills/af-spec/references/ nor skills/_shared/references/`
no output is produced
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/source_test.go: problems = check(fsys); assert problems == [that exact line]

tests.title: One reference file name in both the skill's own and the shared directory is a problem, not an override
given: skills/af-spec/references/speca-specr.md and skills/_shared/references/speca-specr.md, both present
tests.when: the source tree is checked
then: one problem is reported
it names speca-specr.md and both directories
no output is produced for any agent
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/source_test.go: problems = check(fsys); assert one problem mentioning 'speca-specr.md', 'skills/af-spec/references/' and 'skills/_shared/references/'

tests.title: A skill with no SKILL.md, no frontmatter or frontmatter that is not YAML is a problem naming which
given: three source trees: skills/af-x/ with only references/a.md; skills/af-x/SKILL.md starting with # af-x; skills/af-x/SKILL.md whose frontmatter body is `name: [unclosed`
tests.when: each tree is checked in turn
then: each yields exactly one problem
the first names skills/af-x as holding no SKILL.md
the second names skills/af-x/SKILL.md as having no frontmatter
the third names skills/af-x/SKILL.md and that its frontmatter is not YAML
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/source_test.go, a table over the three trees: for each, problems = check(fsys); assert len(problems) == 1 and problems[0] matches the expected `<path>: <problem>`

tests.title: A name is refused when it is missing, differs from its directory or breaks the Agent Skills rule
given: a valid skill directory skills/af-spec whose frontmatter name is varied
tests.when: the name is absent; is af-impl; is Af-Spec; is af--spec; is -af-spec; is af-spec-; is 65 characters; is a single character a; is 64 characters
then: the first seven are each one problem naming the rule broken
the single character a and the 64-character name are accepted when the directory carries the same name
no output is produced for any agent when a name is refused
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/render_test.go, a table of name -> wantProblem: problems = check(treeWithName(name)); assert (len(problems) > 0) == wantProblem

tests.title: A description is refused when it is missing, empty or over 1,024 characters
given: a valid skill directory whose frontmatter description is varied
tests.when: the description is absent; is the empty string; is 1,024 characters; is 1,025 characters
then: the absent and empty descriptions are each one problem
1,024 characters is accepted
1,025 characters is one problem naming the limit
no output is produced for any agent when a description is refused
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/render_test.go, a table of description length -> wantProblem

tests.title: A rendered frontmatter keeps only the agent's keys, in the source's order and with its own text
given: a SKILL.md whose frontmatter is, in this order, name, description over two lines, argument-hint, disable-model-invocation and metadata with two nested keys
tests.when: the skill is rendered for claude, codex, cursor and copilot in turn
then: claude keeps name, description, argument-hint and disable-model-invocation and drops metadata
codex keeps name and description only
cursor keeps name, description and disable-model-invocation and drops argument-hint
copilot keeps name and description only
every kept key appears in the source's order, with its source text and its continuation lines byte for byte
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/render_test.go, a table over the four agents: out = render(skill, agent); assert frontmatterKeys(out) == want; assert the description's second line is present unchanged

tests.title: The invoke token becomes the agent's syntax and no other byte of the body or a reference file changes
given: a body holding {{invoke af-impl}} twice and a reference file holding {{invoke af-prd}} once, both with surrounding prose, a code block and a table
tests.when: the skill is rendered for claude, codex, cursor and copilot in turn
then: claude, cursor and copilot carry /af-impl and /af-prd
codex carries $af-impl and $af-prd
both occurrences in the body are replaced
the rendered body and reference file are byte-identical to the source apart from the replaced tokens
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/render_test.go, a table over the four agents: out = render(skill, agent); assert out.body == strings.ReplaceAll(source.body, '{{invoke af-impl}}', want)

tests.title: An invoke token naming no skill, and any other brace token, are problems
given: a source tree whose only skills are af-prd, af-spec and af-impl
tests.when: a body holds {{invoke af-fix}}; a body holds {{ARGUMENTS}}; a reference file holds {{invoke}} with no name
then: each case yields one problem naming the source file and the token
the problem for {{invoke af-fix}} names af-fix as a skill that does not exist
no output is produced for any agent
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/render_test.go, a table of token -> expected problem text

tests.title: An argument placeholder or a skill named in an agent's own syntax is a problem, while a path in prose is not
given: a source tree whose skills are af-prd, af-spec and af-impl
tests.when: a body holds $ARGUMENTS; a body holds `/af-impl <NN>` in a code block; a body holds $af-impl after a space; a body holds the path skills/af-impl/references/landing.md in prose; a reference file holds the word spec/af-impl
then: $ARGUMENTS, /af-impl and $af-impl are each one problem naming the text found and {{invoke af-impl}} as its replacement
the path skills/af-impl/references/landing.md is no problem
spec/af-impl is no problem
no output is produced for any agent when a problem is reported
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/render_test.go, a table of body text -> wantProblem, covering the delimiters backtick, open paren, open bracket, double quote, line start and whitespace on the left and whitespace, line end and punctuation on the right

tests.title: The body ceiling is measured in bytes after the frontmatter and after substitution, and reference files are not measured
given: a skill whose frontmatter is 300 bytes and whose body length is set per case, and a reference file of 60,000 bytes
tests.when: the body is 24,576 bytes; is 24,577 bytes; is 24,576 bytes only because a multi-byte character is counted as one character rather than its bytes; is 24,570 bytes in the source but grows past the ceiling when {{invoke af-impl}} becomes $af-impl for codex
then: 24,576 bytes is accepted for all four agents
24,577 bytes is one problem reading `skills/af-x/SKILL.md: body is 24,577 bytes for claude, 1 over the 24,576-byte limit`
the multi-byte case is refused, because the measure is bytes of UTF-8 and not characters
the case that grows past the ceiling only after substitution is refused for the agent whose substitution is longer, and the frontmatter's 300 bytes are counted in no case
the 60,000-byte reference file is rendered with no problem about its size
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/render_test.go, a table of body -> per-agent want: problems = check(tree); assert the exact overage line for the failing agent

tests.title: Every problem of a run is reported, one to a line, and nothing is written for any agent
given: a source tree with four problems at once: a broken link in af-prd, a name that differs from its directory in af-spec, an unknown invoke token in af-impl and a body over the ceiling in af-impl
an output directory already holding a file from a previous run
tests.when: the render is asked to write the output tree
then: all four problems are on stderr, each on its own line in the form `<source path>: <problem>`
the exit code is non-zero
the output directory still holds exactly the file from the previous run and nothing new
no agent's directory was created
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/check_test.go: code, stderr = run(['--out', tmp]); assert code != 0; assert 4 lines, each matching '^[^:]+: '; assert the listing of tmp is unchanged

tests.title: A reference file nothing links is a warning that leaves the exit code 0
given: skills/af-impl/references/old.md, which no file links
skills/_shared/references/unused.md, which no skill links
an otherwise clean source tree
tests.when: the render runs
then: stderr carries `skills/af-impl/references/old.md: linked by nothing; not rendered`
stderr carries a line naming skills/_shared/references/unused.md as linked by nothing
the exit code is 0
neither file is in any agent's output
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/check_test.go: code, stderr = run(['--out', tmp]); assert code == 0; assert both warning lines; assert neither file under tmp

tests.title: The render writes a tree per agent, writes the same bytes on a rerun, and leaves nothing stale behind
given: a clean source tree of three skills with their own and shared reference files
an empty output directory
tests.when: the render runs, then runs again unchanged, then runs again after a reference file and a whole skill have been removed from the source
then: the first run writes <out>/<agent>/<name>/SKILL.md and <out>/<agent>/<name>/references/ for all four agents and every skill, and exits 0
each references/ holds exactly that skill's included files and no other
the second run writes bytes identical to the first, file for file
after the third run the removed reference file and the removed skill's directory are gone from every agent's output
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/render_test.go, against a real temporary directory: run(['--out', tmp]); snap1 = hashTree(tmp); run again; assert hashTree(tmp) == snap1; remove sources; run again; assert the removed paths are absent for all four agents

tests.title: The render succeeds with no credential in the environment and no reachable network
given: a clean source tree
an environment with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and every other API key unset, and HTTP_PROXY and HTTPS_PROXY pointing at a closed local port
tests.when: the render runs
then: the exit code is 0
the output tree is complete for all four agents
no error about a credential or a connection is reported
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/render_test.go: t.Setenv('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY',''), t.Setenv('HTTPS_PROXY','http://127.0.0.1:1'); code = run(['--out', tmp]); assert code == 0

tests.title: The install directory is resolved per agent, with PROJECT and SKILLS_DIR taking precedence in that order
given: HOME set to a temporary directory
CODEX_HOME set in one case and unset in another
tests.when: each of the four agents is resolved with no PROJECT and no SKILLS_DIR; with PROJECT set; with SKILLS_DIR set; and with both PROJECT and SKILLS_DIR set
then: with neither, the directories are ~/.claude/skills, $CODEX_HOME/skills, ~/.cursor/skills and ~/.copilot/skills, and ~/.codex/skills for codex when CODEX_HOME is unset
with PROJECT, they are <PROJECT>/.claude/skills, <PROJECT>/.agents/skills, <PROJECT>/.cursor/skills and <PROJECT>/.github/skills
with SKILLS_DIR, it is SKILLS_DIR for every agent
with both, SKILLS_DIR wins
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/install_test.go, a table of (agent, project, skillsDir, codexHome) -> want: got, err = installDir(...); assert got == want

tests.title: An install copies each skill, names where it put it, replaces the directory whole and leaves its neighbours alone
given: a clean source tree of three skills
an install directory already holding af-spec/SKILL.md, af-spec/references/stale.md and an unrelated other-skill/SKILL.md
tests.when: the install runs for claude with no AGENT given, then runs again after a reference file has been removed from the source
then: each skill is at <dir>/<name>/SKILL.md with its references/, and the exit code is 0
stdout carries one line per skill reading `installed: <name> -> <dir>/<name>`
af-spec/references/stale.md is gone after the first install
other-skill/SKILL.md is untouched after both installs
the reference file removed from the source is gone from <dir>/<name>/references/ after the second install
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/install_test.go, against a real temporary HOME: code, stdout = run(['--install','--skills-dir',dir]); assert code == 0; assert the installed: lines; assert stale.md absent and other-skill intact

tests.title: An install over a source tree with a problem installs nothing and reports the problems
given: a source tree with a broken link and a body over the ceiling
an install directory holding one unrelated file
tests.when: the install runs
then: the exit code is non-zero
stderr carries both problems, one to a line, as the render reports them
stdout carries no installed: line
the install directory still holds exactly the unrelated file
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/install_test.go: code, out, errOut = run(['--install','--skills-dir',dir]); assert code != 0; assert listing(dir) unchanged

tests.title: An unknown agent and a PROJECT that is not a directory are refused with their own messages
given: a clean source tree
an install directory holding one unrelated file
tests.when: AGENT is gemini; PROJECT is a path that does not exist; PROJECT is a path that is a regular file
then: AGENT=gemini gives stderr `unknown agent "gemini"; one of: claude, codex, cursor, copilot` and a non-zero exit code
each PROJECT case gives stderr `PROJECT <path> is not a directory` and a non-zero exit code
the install directory is unchanged in all three cases
nothing is rendered in all three cases
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/install_test.go, a table of flags -> exact stderr line and non-zero exit

tests.title: Installing for an agent that also loads another agent's directory warns and installs anyway
given: HOME holding ~/.claude/skills/af-spec/SKILL.md from an earlier claude install
a clean source tree
tests.when: the install runs for copilot into ~/.copilot/skills
then: stderr carries `warning: copilot also loads ~/.claude/skills/af-spec; it will see af-spec twice`, with the path expanded
the exit code is 0
~/.copilot/skills/af-spec/SKILL.md exists
~/.claude/skills/af-spec is untouched
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/install_test.go, against a real temporary HOME: code, errOut = run(['--install','--agent','copilot']); assert code == 0; assert the warning line; assert both directories hold af-spec

tests.title: An uninstall removes the three skills from the resolved directory and nothing else
given: an install directory holding af-prd/, af-spec/, an unrelated other-skill/ and a loose file notes.md
af-impl not installed
tests.when: the uninstall runs against that directory
then: af-prd/ and af-spec/ are gone and stdout carries `removed: af-prd` and `removed: af-spec`
no line is printed for af-impl
other-skill/ and notes.md are still there
the exit code is 0
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/install_test.go: code, stdout = run(['--uninstall','--skills-dir',dir]); assert code == 0; assert the two removed: lines and no third; assert listing(dir) == ['other-skill','notes.md']

tests.title: The repository's own skills tree renders for all four agents with no problem
given: the repository's committed skills/ directory as the source
tests.when: the render checks and writes it for claude, codex, cursor and copilot into a temporary directory
then: the exit code is 0
stderr carries no line of the form `<source path>: <problem>`
every skill under skills/ is present for all four agents
each rendered body is at most 24,576 bytes for every agent
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/render_test.go, reading the real tree at ../../skills: code, errOut = run(['--source','../../skills','--out',tmp]); assert code == 0 and no problem lines. This is the one test that reads the repository's own skills; it asserts the render's verdict on them, not their wording.

tests.title: The build lists the render's targets, runs its checks inside check, and cleans its output
given: the repository's Makefile
tests.when: make help is run, and the plans of make check and make clean are read with make -n
then: make help lists skills, skills-check, install-skills and uninstall-skills, each with its description
the plan of make check runs the render's checks after the test step
the plan of make check contains no command that reads an API key or reaches the network for the render's checks
the plan of make clean removes the directory that holds build/skills
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/make_test.go: out = exec('make','help'); assert the four targets; plan = exec('make','-n','check'); assert skills-check appears after the go test line; plan = exec('make','-n','clean'); assert it removes build. make check is read with -n and never run from a test, because running it would re-enter go test.

tests.title: A maintainer runs make skills and reads a rendered skill for codex
given: a checkout whose skills/ tree is the committed one
no build/skills directory
tests.when: make skills is run and build/skills/codex/af-spec/SKILL.md is read
then: make skills exits 0
build/skills/<agent>/<name>/SKILL.md exists for all four agents and every skill
the codex af-spec frontmatter holds name and description and no argument-hint
its body carries $af-impl where the source carries {{invoke af-impl}}
its references/ holds the files that skill links
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/smoke_test.go, running the real make target in the checkout: exec('make','skills'); read build/skills/codex/af-spec/SKILL.md and assert its frontmatter and its invocation syntax

tests.title: A maintainer installs the skills into a scratch repository for codex and removes them again
given: a scratch directory standing in for a repository
the committed skills/ tree
tests.when: make install-skills AGENT=codex PROJECT=<scratch> is run, then make uninstall-skills AGENT=codex PROJECT=<scratch>
then: the install exits 0 and prints installed: <name> -> <scratch>/.agents/skills/<name> for each skill
<scratch>/.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md and its references/ exist for each skill
the uninstall exits 0 and prints removed: <name> for each skill
<scratch>/.agents/skills holds none of the three skills afterwards
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/smoke_test.go: exec('make','install-skills','AGENT=codex','PROJECT='+scratch); assert the tree and the lines; exec('make','uninstall-skills',...); assert the three directories are gone

tests.title: A maintainer sees the render's checks name every rule a broken skill breaks, and write nothing
given: a copy of the committed skills/ tree with a link to a reference file that does not exist added to one skill and another skill's body padded past the ceiling
no output tree
tests.when: make skills-check is run against that source
then: the exit code is non-zero
stderr carries one line for the broken link, naming the file and both references directories
stderr carries one line for the body over the ceiling, naming the agent, the size and the overage
no output tree was written
tests.pseudocode: in internal/skillgen/smoke_test.go: copy skills/ to a scratch tree, break it twice, exec('make','skills-check','SKILLS_SRC='+scratch); assert the non-zero exit, both lines and that no output directory exists
real_components: a broken copy of the skills source tree
